utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Can you hear me all right? Teams is having one of its mornings.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Better than the traffic on the ring road. Spent twenty minutes looking at the same rear bumper.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: You and me both. Traffic on the ring road was properly backed up when I came through.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Still warmer in the car than here. The heating in the portakabin seems to be mostly decorative.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's why you've still got your coat on. Thought you'd just arrived.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the weather report. Wednesday 04 November. Quick look at what's finished, then the live jobs.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I signed off the inspection on the line 2 guard on Tuesday. That's closed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, saw that. Nothing outstanding on that inspection from production.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the waste heat boiler yesterday. Finished job, not carrying it into today.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. Yesterday's work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Also, I tested the FLTs yesterday and it's all fine now. That testing's done.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, separate from that, I'll do the pre-use checks on the forklifts at half two.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace. That's the pre-use checks, not reopening yesterday's testing.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. Different thing. Just don't want those getting muddled together.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, can you also grease and check the bearings on the Gas Turbine 1 by 11am? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll grease and check the bearings on the Gas Turbine 1 by 11am. Normal priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, someone crackled over that. Eleven for the bearings?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's right, by 11am for the bearings. Forklifts at half two.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Anything else from your side before we get into maintenance?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just an observation: saw the pressure on the HV board dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Came back without anyone doing anything?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, on its own. Just reporting what I saw, not putting a new job on the list.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And we're still waiting on parts for the HV switchboard, nothing we can do until they arrive. That's still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, still waiting. There's no arrival update to change that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, stays blocked. Not an action for somebody to pick up today.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Same sort of thing with the IM1. Can't get to the IM1 until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, and there's no window agreed. Don't count that as released work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. No allocation on that while it's blocked.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Oh, and we were going to replace the belt on the line 3 barrel but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Ah, right. That was on the old list I was looking at.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Not for today, then. That belt replacement's off this stand-up's actions.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tom, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Fire Alarm Panel by the 28th? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Fire Alarm Panel by the 28th. Got it as top priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Sorry, just separating those in my head—sign-off there, but who's got the permit and isolation side?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus, can you sort the permit to work and isolation for the fire panel by Thursday? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the fire panel by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, so those are separate bits. I heard 'panel' twice and thought we'd crossed over.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Separate responsibilities, yeah. Not giving the same job to two people.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And understood on the urgency—not an emergency, but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll run the monthly fire alarm test by the 28th as well. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—that applies to mine too.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: So the monthly fire alarm test is yours, Sarah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, mine. I'll run it by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Cheers. Your audio dropped for a second, only caught the end of that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No worries. At least it dropped during me talking, which probably improved things.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next one, Tomasz Nowak, can you go to the warehouse to pick up the replacement parts for the GT2 Number 2 Bearing next week? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Full name! Sounds like I'm back at school.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Only because you were laughing over me. Next week for that collection, but drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. I'll go to the warehouse to pick up the replacement parts for the GT2 Number 2 Bearing next week. That takes precedence.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's collection only, yeah? Not fitting the bearing under the same action?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct, just picking up the replacement parts. No fitting job being added here.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fine by me. Collection only.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you replace the seals on the booster pump by Wednesday? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Actual seal replacement, not just getting the seals out of stores?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, replace the seals on the booster pump. By Wednesday, and drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Right, accepted. I'll replace the seals on the booster pump by Wednesday. That goes first.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Gets you out of the cold portakabin, anyway.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Knew there'd be a silver lining somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, enough career advice from the cheap seats. Everyone clear on what they've accepted?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah. Nothing new from me; the filter I mentioned was yesterday's completed work.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Clear here. And no sneaking that cancelled belt job back in from the old list.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, clear. My observation and the parts hold aren't extra actions.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: All clear from me too.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. That's us, then. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Cheers. Ending the call before my fingers freeze to the keyboard.
